title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about iziTools

items.question: Are the tools free to use?
items.answer: Yes, all tools on iziTools are completely free to use. There are no signups required, no hidden costs, and no limitations on usage.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. All tools process data locally in your browser. We don't store, transmit, or have access to any of your data. Your privacy is our priority.

items.question: Can I use these tools offline?
items.answer: Most tools work offline once the page is loaded. However, some tools that require external APIs may need an internet connection.

items.question: How often are new tools added?
items.answer: We regularly add new tools based on user feedback and common needs. Check back frequently or follow us for updates on new additions.

items.question: Can I suggest a new tool?
items.answer: Yes! We welcome tool suggestions. Please contact us through our contact page or submit an issue on our GitHub repository.

items.question: Do you support mobile devices?
items.answer: Yes, all tools are fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices. Use iziTools anywhere, anytime.
